description: A MAUI Windows app throws `Class not registered` in the Windows App SDK DeploymentManager auto-initializer when launched on a new machine, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79315506/class-not-registered-when-trying-to-run-maui-app.
prompt: I'm trying to run a MAUI Windows app from a repo that worked on another laptop, but this machine throws before the app initializes: `System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException HResult=0x80040154 Message=Class not registered` at `Microsoft.Windows.ApplicationModel.WindowsAppRuntime.DeploymentInitializeOptions..ctor()` and then `DeploymentManagerCS.AutoInitialize.AccessWindowsAppSDK()`. Installing the x64 runtime did not change it.
